reply.label: secret
reply.reason: `grep` prints every line matching a secret name; in .env that line is `NAME=value`.
reply.suggestion: Names only: `grep -rl NAME .` or `rg -l NAME`. Then read lines in source: `grep -n NAME src/app.js`.

reply.reason: `cat` on secret store `.env` would print it.
reply.suggestion: Don't print it. Load it: `set -a; . ./.env; set +a`. Check it's set: `[ -n "$KEY" ] && echo set`.
